verdict.rationale: mParticle's marketing site says it can score likelihood to churn, convert, or grow in value and then activate audiences on those scores, and its docs cover connecting audiences to outputs for targeting. However, the predictive-scoring claim appears only as a one-line marketing statement, and nothing in the pack shows computed or calculated traits on profiles. Missing for 10: evidence of computed/calculated traits on profiles, in-depth docs on predictive score models (LTV, churn, purchase propensity) and how they are stored on profiles, independent or hands-on corroboration.
